summary: Iteration-3 testing of Promethius Orb-mode additions. Backend: 5/5 new iteration-3 tests passed + 24/24 regression all green. End-to-end verified: GET /api/voice/voices returns 21 ElevenLabs voices (key valid), PUT /api/settings persists chosen voice_id and GET /api/auth/me reflects it, POST /api/voice/tts returns audio/mpeg bytes (>1KB) using the saved voice, auto long-term memory works — after a single POST /api/chat (anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6) stating durable facts ('My name is Marcus..., astrophysicist, prefer concise answers'), background extract_and_store_memory() inserted auto:true entries within ~4-8s that captured 'marcus', 'astronom', 'astrophys' and 'concise' keywords. Default Anthropic chat still replies. Frontend (admin@promethius.ai): all 8 UI checks passed end-to-end — default route '/' renders orb-canvas + orb-status ('Tap the orb to awaken Promethius'), all 3 top-right controls (settings, open-chat, logout) work, Voice Settings modal opens, lists 21 voice-option-<id> entries, selecting one persists silently and closes via close-settings-button, orb-open-chat-button navigates to /chat (sidebar with 'New chat' visible), back-to-orb-button returns to '/' (orb re-renders), settings-link in sidebar reopens the voice modal, logout returns to /login. Zero console errors / pageerrors during the entire flow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1000 lines — same recommendation as iteration_2 to split into routers (auth, chat, voice, image, video, tools, scheduled, memory, vault, projects, journal, admin) still stands.

extract_and_store_memory uses claude-haiku-4-5 with a strict JSON-array system prompt and dedupes against existing facts (substring containment in both directions) — clean design, working as intended. Caps at 400 memories — sensible.

Orb.jsx correctly guards SpeechRecognition with supportsSR feature flag and falls back to MediaRecorder push-to-talk + /voice/transcribe — graceful degradation in headless environments (verified: zero JS errors).
VoiceSettings.jsx uses Promise.all([/voice/voices, /auth/me]) for a single render pass — good UX.
PUT /api/settings only updates voice_id if truthy — won't accidentally null it. Returns {ok, voice_id}.
All new endpoints carry the /api prefix, JWT auth dependency applied, no Mongo _id leakage.
